scope: Protocol actionability approval, not implementation approval or an observed scientific result
resolved_v1_blockers: Extract ordinary-rule predicate into a standard-library-only reference module without importing the runtime-bearing comparison runner
Evaluate initial and repaired final candidates against one immutable reference PRE-ACTION state, differing only in BFS-derived reachability
claim_limits: Implementation-separated reference, not blinded or independently annotated ground truth
Exact structural-signature retention, not linguistic diversity or creativity
Authored surface coverage sentinels, not a natural-language leakage rate or renderer safety result
Finite reusable-key graph crosscheck, not gameplay validation
No ontology-correctness, model/multi-model or human efficacy claim
reviewer_execution: Read-only source inspection; no commands, tests, builds, formatters, linters, network or experiment/model operations
